description: This file defines the REST API resource for self-managed clients in the Fineract microfinance platform. It provides endpoints for listing clients, retrieving specific client details, managing client images, charges, transactions, and associated accounts, with security and access control checks.

classes.name: SelfClientsApiResource
classes.description: REST resource class providing endpoints for self-managed clients, including listing, fetching details, images, charges, transactions, and related accounts with access control.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Lists clients associated with the authenticated user, supports pagination, sorting, and filtering.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific client by ID.

methods.name: retrieveAssociatedAccounts
methods.description: Retrieves overview of client accounts like loans and savings.

methods.name: retrieveImage
methods.description: Retrieves the image associated with a client.

methods.name: retrieveAllClientCharges
methods.description: Lists charges applicable to a specific client, supports pagination.

methods.name: retrieveClientCharge
methods.description: Retrieves details for a specific client charge.

methods.name: retrieveAllClientTransactions
methods.description: Lists transactions for a specific client with pagination.

methods.name: retrieveClientTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific transaction for a client.

methods.name: addNewClientImage
methods.description: Uploads and associates a new image with a client, either via multipart/form-data or JSON.

methods.name: deleteClientImage
methods.description: Deletes the image associated with a client.

methods.name: retrieveObligeeDetails
methods.description: Retrieves obligee details for a client.

methods.name: validateAppuserClientsMapping
methods.description: Checks if the current user is mapped to the specified client ID; throws exception if not.
